sentence_stem: Ali is always late for school because
correct_completion: he wakes up late every day.
full_sentence: Ali is always late for school because he wakes up late every day.
acceptable_variants: he goes to bed very late.

options.why_wrong: This is a true sentence about Ali, but it does not explain why he is late for school, so it does not complete the cause relation.

options.text: the school is near his house.
options.why_wrong: This gives a fact about distance. It does not explain the lateness, because a near school would make him arrive earlier, not later.

options.text: he wake up late every day.
options.why_wrong: The idea is right, but the verb is wrong. With he, the present simple needs an -s ending: 'he wakes up'.

options.text: he wakes up late every day.

grammar_focus: Cause with 'because' and present simple third person
explanation: The word 'because' introduces the reason for the first clause. The reason must use the present simple, with the verb in third person singular (wakes).
